class.name: SteamServices
class.brief_description: Resolve the Steam scope already attached to a game.

method.name: for_game
method.description: Return the exact game's Steam scope. A failed setup exposes its diagnostic. Closed games and games without Steam return null.

method.name: current
method.description: Return Steam for the selected or sole active GameRuntime.

method.name: server_for
method.description: Return the exact Steam dedicated attachment, including an unavailable attachment with a diagnostic. Return null for a client or non-Steam provider.
